releases.title: The engine viewport is now self-healing
fixes: The AMLL engine's zero viewport is now re-seeded until it sticks: the seed walks up from the host to the nearest sized ancestor (the host can still measure 0x0 at the moment the mode switches on), and the drive loop re-seeds every frame while the viewport is still zero, so no animation depends on the engine's own resize observer recovering

releases.title: AMLL: the engine finally gets a real viewport, so the animations run
fixes: Fixed Simple lyrics rendering but never animating - no scale, no word bounce, no background-vocal slide, no spring glide. The engine was reporting its own viewport size as 0x0 because it attaches its ResizeObserver to its root element inside the constructor, while that element is still detached, and nothing ever corrected it. A zero viewport zeroes the default line height and makes the engine's in-render-range check bail for every line, so it never committed a single transform - while the karaoke fill kept working because that is written from a different code path. The size is now seeded from the host we control and kept in sync by our own observer

releases.title: Diagnostic build for the missing AMLL animations
fixes: Drive the engine's play state from its own reported state rather than a cached copy, so a state mismatch self-corrects on the next frame instead of persisting
Adds a temporary data-debug dump on the AMLL host so the converted word timings and engine state can be read straight off the page while diagnosing the remaining animation gap

releases.title: The karaoke sweep actually sweeps
fixes: Fixed the missing left-to-right fill in Simple lyrics. The engine was using its Web Animations mask path, which only re-plays a line's karaoke animation at the instant that line becomes active and trusts the engine's own play-state flag - when that flag went stale the animation stayed paused at a fixed mask-position, leaving every word parked in the dim state with no sweep. It now uses the engine's calc mask path, which recomputes the mask position from the playback time on every single frame and has no play-state dependency at all

releases.title: AMLL: correct word splits, a karaoke fill that can't freeze, and bolder type
fixes: Fixed words being split apart where they should be joined, and joined where they should split - "leave medigni fied" now renders as "leave me dignified". The adapter was guessing word boundaries from IsPartOfWord, which the parser infers as "no whitespace between the tags" and is true for adjacent whole words too. It now uses HasSpaceBefore, which is measured from the actual markup, and only falls back to IsPartOfWord when the source recorded no spacing at all

The karaoke sweep could freeze mid-word: the engine only re-plays a line's animation when that line becomes active and trusts its own isPlaying flag, which time deltas kept stale during buffering and seeks. Play state now comes from the YouTube Music player itself, and the active line's animation is nudged every frame
Simple lyrics now draws slightly chunkier - the bundled face stops at weight 700, so a half-pixel stroke thickens the glyphs without a faux-bold fudge (the karaoke mask still clips it correctly)

releases.title: AMLL: real word spacing, per-word karaoke fill and the bold font
fixes: Fixed Simple lyrics running every word together ("everywordlookslikethis") and having no left-to-right karaoke fill. Both came from the same cause: AMLL groups consecutive non-whitespace words into a single element, and Aurora's syllables carry no whitespace, so each line collapsed into one element holding the whole line. The adapter now inserts explicit space atoms at word boundaries - skipped inside split words (IsPartOfWord) and between CJK glyphs, and never doubled when the source already has one
Simple lyrics now uses the Spicy Lyrics bold face (weight 700, LyricsBold.woff2), matching the weight the built-in renderer uses, instead of the lighter 500

releases.title: AMLL engine runs under YouTube's Trusted Types policy
fixes: Fixed the AMLL engine mounting but never rendering a frame. music.youtube.com enforces a Trusted Types CSP (require-trusted-types-for 'script'), so the engine's innerHTML assignments threw "This document requires 'TrustedHTML' assignment" inside DomLyricPlayer.update(), which aborted the drive loop and dropped back to the built-in renderer. All six innerHTML clears in the vendored engine now use replaceChildren(), which is not a Trusted Types sink
A single failed frame no longer disables the engine for the rest of the session - drive errors are retried and only fall back after roughly a second of continuous failure

releases.title: The real AMLL engine actually loads now
fixes: Fixed Simple lyrics silently running Aurora's built-in fallback renderer instead of the real AMLL engine - which looked like "the old animation, just without the glow". The loader resolved amll-core.js with chrome.runtime.getURL(), but the bundle runs in the page's MAIN world where chrome.runtime is undefined, so it threw "extension URL unavailable" and fell back every time. It now resolves the module from document.currentScript.src, the same way the Kawarp module already does

A failed engine load no longer leaves the panel in a half-active state that could hide the built-in lyrics; the failure latch also clears when the mode is switched off, so a transient load error retries instead of wedging the fallback for the whole session

releases.title: Lyrics panel mounts again in every mode
fixes: Fixed the lyrics panel disappearing entirely (with Apple-Music-style lyrics both on and off). A `typeof import` guard in the AMLL loader was a syntax error - `import` is an always-reserved keyword - so the browser rejected the whole classic-script bundle with "Cannot use import statement outside a module" before a single line ran, and the panel UI was never created. The guard is gone; dynamic import is always available in Chrome MV3

Also fixed a scope bug where the AMLL integration was appended after the shared IIFE had closed, putting its functions outside the scope that owns panelEl - the build now emits it inside the IIFE, before the boot fragment

The build script now compiles the bundle with vm.Script (classic-script grammar, the same one Chrome uses) and refuses to emit it if it does not parse, so a static import/export or reserved-word misuse can never silently ship again. node --check was not enough: it is lenient and let this through

releases.title: Simple lyrics now uses the real AMLL engine
features: Simple lyrics is now powered by the actual @applemusic-like-lyrics (AMLL) DomLyricPlayer engine - imported and driven every frame, so the scroll physics, spring motion, per-word emphasis on long words and the karaoke mask are byte-for-byte the upstream behaviour, not an approximation
Lyrics are adapted from Aurora's parsed model into AMLL's LyricLine[] (seconds to milliseconds) and the Spicy Lyrics font is forced onto the engine's host, exactly like the AMLL preview
Falls back to Aurora's built-in glow-free Simple renderer on any engine error, so the mode can never break; the whole-line text-shadow glow is also removed

releases.title: Simple lyrics is now the Apple Music / AMLL style
features: Simple lyrics mode now renders like the AMLL (Apple Music Like Lyrics) preview: white lyric text that blooms over the backdrop via mix-blend-mode plus-lighter, a per-word white gradient sweep on the active line, the active line scaled up with a soft white halo, and lines that fade with distance from the one playing
Background vocals keep their own dimmer, smaller treatment inside Simple lyrics, and the Spicy Lyrics font is used throughout

releases.title: Music-video to cover no longer lags
fixes: MV -> cover-art now dissolves the controls as soon as the video is gone, instead of waiting out the full mode-change debounce - it lands in step with the song like cover -> MV does
MV -> MV is still left perfectly still: a short probe only fades the controls if the player video is actually gone by ~170ms after the skip

releases.title: The fullscreen fade is now in step with the song
fixes: The control dissolve on a cover-art <-> music-video skip now fires with the track change itself, so the controls fade out on the same beat the media does instead of a beat late when the next video finished attaching
Trimmed the music-video -> cover-art detection delay so that fade lands in the middle of the transition instead of after it

releases.title: The fullscreen fade actually shows now
fixes: The control dissolve on a music-video <-> cover-art skip now has a minimum visible hold, so it can no longer be cancelled the instant the next video is ready - the controls fade out and back in every time, instead of only sometimes

releases.title: A cleaner fullscreen fade
fixes: Going from a music video to a cover-art song (and back) now fades the controls with a smooth, deliberate dissolve instead of a near-instant blink - the fullscreen UI reads as polished rather than snappy

releases.title: Fullscreen controls stay put on a skip
fixes: Fullscreen controls no longer vanish when you skip between two music videos - they stay on screen the whole time, like they do on a cover-to-cover skip
If a control fade is ever left stranded, a safety timer now restores it automatically instead of needing a fullscreen reopen

releases.title: A darker update notice
features: The update notice now matches the rest of the app: dark surface, white text and the same font as the panel
The Got it button is red instead of yellow
fixes: The notice is readable over a bright cover art again - the blurred artwork behind it was washing out the text

releases.title: Custom backgrounds and calmer fullscreen
features: Aurora Bloom can use your own image as the page background - warped with Kawarp or softly blurred, with brightness, saturation and contrast controls
Aurora Lyrics settings now live behind their own rail, grouped into Look, Words, Motion, Timing and Font instead of one long list
A Discord invite sits at the top of the add-on list
fixes: Fullscreen controls stay where they are - they no longer drift while a video or cover art loads
Cover art and music videos now hand over with a clean fade in both directions, and music video to music video leaves the controls alone
Switching between a cover art track and a music video no longer shows the wrong layout for a moment first
Uninstalling an add-on now asks you to restart YouTube Music, so no leftover code stays behind
The first-run tour has been removed - a fresh install goes straight to the app
The artist card in the Now Playing rail labels its subscriber count again

releases.title: Update notices
features: Aurora Lyrics now tells you what changed right after it updates
You will also be told when a newer version is available, with a link to the release

releases.title: Popup lyrics match the main panel
features: The popup now uses the same lyric size, settings, romanization and attribution as the main panel
Added a "Jump to current lyric" button that appears while you are scrolled away
Clicking a line in the popup seeks to that point in the track
fixes: The popup no longer snaps back to the active line while you are scrolling
Credits stay in the normal scroll flow instead of overlapping the last line
